# telnyx_public_internet_gateways (Data Source)

Lists public internet gateways, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_public_internet_gateway`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_network_id` (String) The associated network id to filter on.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `public_internet_gateways` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_internet_gateways))

<a id="nestedatt--public_internet_gateways"></a>
### Nested Schema for `public_internet_gateways`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `name` (String) A user specified name for the interface.
- `network_id` (String) The id of the network associated with the interface.
- `public_ip` (String) The publically accessible ip for this interface.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `region_code` (String) The region interface is deployed to.
- `status` (String) The current status of the interface deployment.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
